NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: 02.12 22:30 - 04:30 An internet service provider near Dark Ages server had a serious internet problem. The ISP's problem temporarily slowed Dark Ages game play nearly to a halt. The ISP fixed their fault. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
